message.zh: Tibi 0.2.1 已发布：修复 macOS 播客本地音频播放偶发闪退，精简默认订阅与电台源，完善可选使用统计并在首次引导开放选择，同步优化多处稳定性与安全细节。
message.en: Tibi 0.2.1 is out: fixes a macOS crash during local podcast audio playback, streamlines default feeds and podcasts, refines optional usage analytics with an onboarding choice, and improves stability and security across the app.
